examShortTricks: Trick 1: Definition: protein from MICROBIAL biomass (Spirulina, Methylophilus methylotrophus, yeast, Chlorella) grown on waste — the microbe names are the marks.
Trick 2: Merits: high protein (Spirulina >50%), fast growth (microbes double in hours), uses waste substrate, little land/water — four merits.
Trick 3: 250 kg cow vs 250 g microbe comparison: microbe produces ~25 tonnes protein/day vs cow 200 g — the classic numerical contrast.
Trick 4: Limitation: public acceptance, texture/taste, contamination control — one line for the balanced answer.
